items.title: Pfizer seeks label expansion for Litfulo after double Phase III NSV win
items.summary: Pfizer’s Litfulo is already approved in alopecia areata; however, the success of the TRANQUILLO programme sets it up for potential approval in NSV.

items.title: Australia approves first-in-class Niktimvo for later-line cGVHD
items.summary: Specialised Therapeutics’ Niktimvo (axatilimab) was registered in the Australian Register of Therapeutic Goods for later-line cGVHD.

items.title: EU regulatory roundup: AbbVie, Pfizer & BioNTech and Incyte net approvals
items.summary: AbbVie's Rinvoq, Pfizer and BioNTech's Comirnaty and Incyte's Opzelura have all received their own EU drug regulatory approvals this week.

items.title: FDA AdCom shuns Capricor’s DMD cell therapy amid data dispute
items.summary: Capricor is adamant its Phase III study showed effectiveness, though panel members called data “fragile”.

items.title: The $1.2tn untapped pharma opportunity in tropical conservation
items.summary: Researchers estimate that pharma could unlock up to $1.2tn in commercial value from tropical forests by supporting biodiversity conservation.
